passages.title: 公車司機林伯伯
passages.text: Every morning, I take the 7:10 bus to school. The bus is always {1} because many students and office workers ride it. Last Monday, I got up late, so I ran {2} the street to catch it. The driver, Mr. Lin, saw me and waited. I was out of breath, and I said "Thank you!" very loudly. He smiled and said, "No need to {3}. I can hear you." Mr. Lin has worked for the bus company for twenty years. He says good {4} is more than driving safely. "It's about making people feel welcome," he told me. He knows many students' names, and he always says good morning to everyone. Thanks to him, I {5} at school on time that day. Now I try to get up earlier, but I still look forward to seeing Mr. Lin every morning.

blanks.why: busy「擁擠的、繁忙的」：很多學生和上班族搭，所以公車總是很擠。afraid（害怕的）、delicious（美味的）、proud（驕傲的）都不能形容公車很擠。
run across the street「跑過馬路」。during（在…期間）、until（直到）、since（自從）都不能表示「從馬路這頭到那頭」。
No need to shout.「不用大聲喊」：前面說我很大聲地說謝謝。arrive（抵達）、borrow（借）、waste（浪費）都和「我聽得到你」接不起來。
good service「好的服務」：司機說好的服務不只是安全駕駛。excuse（藉口）、village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）都不能接 is more than driving safely。
arrive at + 地點「抵達某地」：準時到學校。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，也不能接 at school 表示到達。

passages.zh: 每天早上，我都搭七點十分的公車上學。很多學生和上班族都搭這班車，所以車上總是很擠。上週一我睡過頭，只好跑過馬路去趕車。司機林伯伯看到我，就停下來等我。我喘到上氣不接下氣，很大聲地說了一句「謝謝！」他笑著說：「不用用喊的，我聽得到。」林伯伯在公車公司工作了二十年。他說，好的服務不只是安全駕駛，「而是讓乘客覺得受到歡迎。」他記得很多學生的名字，每天都跟大家說早安。多虧了他，那天我準時到了學校。現在我努力早點起床，但每天早上還是很期待見到林伯伯。

passages.title: 過馬路的鴨子一家
passages.text: One rainy morning, a mother duck and her five babies stood next to a {1} road near our school. Cars and scooters were everywhere. The little ducks were {2} and hid behind their mother. A police officer saw them. He walked into the road, raised his hand, and {3}, "Stop, please!" All the cars stopped. Then the mother duck led her babies {4} the road, one by one. People in the cars clapped, and some students took pictures. One of the videos became popular online. When a reporter asked the officer about it, he laughed. "It was the most {5} job I've done this year," he said. Now there is a new sign near the school. It says, "Slow down. Ducks crossing."

blanks.why: a busy road「車多的馬路」：到處都是汽車和機車。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious（美味的）、fresh（新鮮的）都不能形容馬路。
be afraid「害怕」：小鴨很害怕，躲在媽媽後面。delicious、sharp（尖的）、heavy（重的）都不能說明牠們為什麼要躲。
shout「大喊」：警察舉手大喊「請停車！」。arrived（抵達）、borrowed（借）、wasted（浪費）都不能接說出來的話。
across the road「穿越馬路」：鴨媽媽帶小鴨一隻一隻過馬路。during、since、until 都不能表示從路的一邊到另一邊。
the most interesting job「最有趣的工作」。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、wet（濕的）都不能形容工作。

passages.zh: 一個下雨的早上，一隻鴨媽媽和五隻小鴨站在我們學校附近一條車很多的馬路旁。到處都是汽車和機車，小鴨們很害怕，躲在媽媽後面。一位警察看到了，他走到馬路上，舉起手大喊：「請停車！」所有的車都停了下來。接著鴨媽媽帶著小鴨，一隻接一隻地過了馬路。車裡的人都拍手，有些學生還拍了照片，其中一支影片在網路上爆紅。記者訪問那位警察時，他笑著說：「這是我今年做過最有趣的工作。」現在學校附近多了一塊新的告示牌，上面寫著：「請慢行，鴨子過馬路。」

passages.title: Kevin 的藉口
passages.text: My classmate Kevin is never on time, but he always has a good {1}. On Monday, he said his alarm clock didn't work. On Tuesday, he said a cat was sleeping on his shoes. On Wednesday, he told us he {2} at the wrong school by mistake. His stories were so {3} that the whole class laughed. But our teacher, Ms. Wang, was not happy. On Thursday, she called his mom. "Kevin isn't {4} in the morning," his mom said. "He just plays games in bed." That evening, Kevin's mom took away his phone. "It was a {5} night," Kevin told me the next day. "I had nothing to do, so I went to bed at nine." On Friday, Kevin got to school before everyone else. Ms. Wang smiled and said, "Now that's the best story you've ever told."

blanks.why: a good excuse「好藉口」：Kevin 從來不準時，但總是有好藉口。village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）、size（尺寸）都和遲到的理由無關。
arrive at + 地點「到達某地」：他說他不小心跑到別的學校。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，也不能接 at the wrong school 表示到達。
interesting「有趣的」：故事有趣到全班都笑了。afraid（害怕的）、wet（濕的）、delicious（美味的）都不能形容故事好笑。
busy「忙碌的」：媽媽說 Kevin 早上根本不忙，只是在床上打電動。delicious、wet、poor（窮的）都不能和「在床上打電動」形成對比。
a terrible night「很糟的一晚」：手機被沒收，沒事做只好九點睡。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、sharp（尖的）都不能形容夜晚。

passages.zh: 我的同學 Kevin 從來不準時，但他總有一個好藉口。星期一，他說他的鬧鐘壞了；星期二，他說有隻貓睡在他的鞋子上；星期三，他告訴我們他不小心跑到別的學校去了。他的故事有趣到全班都笑翻了。但我們的王老師可不開心。星期四，她打電話給 Kevin 的媽媽。「Kevin 早上一點都不忙，」他媽媽說，「他只是躺在床上打電動。」那天晚上，Kevin 的媽媽沒收了他的手機。「那一晚超慘的，」隔天 Kevin 跟我說，「我沒事可做，九點就上床睡覺了。」星期五，Kevin 比所有人都早到學校。王老師笑著說：「這才是你說過最棒的故事。」

passages.title: 圖書館的尖叫聲
passages.text: The school library is usually very quiet, but last week something {1} happened. I was reading a book about space when a big black spider walked {2} the page. I jumped up and {3}, "Help!" Everyone looked at me, and my face turned red. "Um, {4} me," I said quietly. "There's a spider on my book." The librarian, Mr. Chen, came over with a paper cup. "Don't be {5}," he said. "It's more scared of you than you are of it." He put the spider in the cup and carried it outside to the garden. The other students went back to their books, but a few of them were still smiling. Now I always check my books before I start reading, and I sit near the window, far away from the dark corners.

blanks.why: something terrible「可怕的事」。afraid 不能這樣修飾 something；delicious（美味的）、proud（驕傲的）都不能說明圖書館發生的事。
walk across + 物「爬過、走過」：蜘蛛從書頁上爬過去。during、since、until 都不能接 the page 表示經過的地方。
shout「大叫」：我跳起來大叫「救命！」。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
Excuse me.「不好意思」：打擾大家時的禮貌用語。burn（燒）、waste（浪費）、bite（咬）都不能和 me 組成道歉的話。
Don't be afraid.「別怕」：下一句說蜘蛛比你更怕你。busy、delicious、wet 都和蜘蛛無關。

passages.zh: 學校圖書館平常很安靜，但上週發生了一件可怕的事。我正在看一本關於太空的書，突然有一隻大黑蜘蛛從書頁上爬過去。我跳起來大叫：「救命啊！」大家都看著我，我的臉都紅了。「呃，不好意思，」我小聲地說，「我的書上有一隻蜘蛛。」圖書館員陳老師拿著一個紙杯走過來。「別怕，」他說，「牠怕你比你怕牠還多。」他把蜘蛛裝進杯子，拿到外面的花園放掉。其他同學又回去看書了，但有幾個人還在偷笑。現在我開始看書前都會先檢查一下，而且我都坐在窗邊，離那些陰暗的角落遠遠的。

passages.title: 坐錯飛機的行李箱
passages.text: Last summer, my family flew to Tokyo. When we {1} at the airport, we waited for our bags. Other people got their bags one by one, but our big red suitcase never came out. "What a {2} start to our trip!" Mom said. We went to the airline's customer {3} desk. The woman there was very {4} because many people had problems that day, but she helped us kindly. She checked her computer and said, "Your bag is {5} in Osaka. It got on the wrong plane." We all laughed. "Our suitcase went on its own trip!" my brother said. Two days later, the suitcase came to our hotel. Inside, everything was fine, and there was even a little note from the airline: "Sorry for the trouble. Enjoy Japan!"

blanks.why: arrive at + 地點「抵達」：到了東京的機場。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，也不能表示到達。
What a terrible start!「真是糟糕的開始！」：行李不見了。delicious（美味的）、sharp（尖的）都不能形容開始；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
customer service desk「客服櫃台」。village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）、meal（一餐）都不能和 customer 組成處理問題的櫃台。
busy「忙碌的」：那天很多人有問題，所以她很忙。delicious、wet、heavy 都不能和「很多人有問題」連在一起。
somewhere in Osaka「在大阪的某個地方」。ago（以前）、yet（還沒）、ever（曾經）都不能放在 is 和 in Osaka 之間表示位置。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家飛去東京。到了機場後，我們等著領行李。其他人一個個拿到了行李，但我們那個紅色的大行李箱一直沒出來。「這趟旅行的開始真是太慘了！」媽媽說。我們去了航空公司的客服櫃台。那天很多人都有問題，櫃台的小姐忙得不得了，但她還是很親切地幫我們。她查了電腦後說：「您的行李在大阪的某個地方，它搭錯飛機了。」我們全都笑了出來。「我們的行李箱自己去旅行了！」弟弟說。兩天後，行李箱送到了我們的飯店，裡面的東西都好好的，還有一張航空公司寫的小紙條：「造成您的麻煩很抱歉，祝您在日本玩得愉快！」

passages.title: 爸爸泳渡日月潭
passages.text: Every September, thousands of people swim {1} Sun Moon Lake. This year, my dad joined the event for the first time. He is a good swimmer, but he is {2} of deep water. "Then why do you want to do it?" I asked. "I want to show you that we can beat our fears," he said. On the day of the swim, the weather was {3}. It was windy and rainy, but the event didn't stop. Dad swam slowly and carefully for three kilometers. My mom and I waited at the finish line for almost two hours. When he finally {4}, we {5} his name and cheered. He was tired and cold, but he had a big smile on his face. "That was the hardest thing I've ever done," he said. "Next year, you're coming with me."

blanks.why: swim across + 湖「游過、橫渡」：泳渡日月潭。during、since、until 都不能表示從湖的一邊游到另一邊。
be afraid of + 物「害怕…」：他怕深水。busy、delicious、sharp 都不能接 of deep water 表示害怕。
terrible「很糟的」：又颳風又下雨，天氣很差。afraid（害怕的）、delicious（美味的）、proud（驕傲的）都不能形容天氣。
arrive「到達」：他終於游到終點。borrowed、wasted、invited 後面都要接受詞，這裡沒有受詞，句子不完整。
shout + 名字「大喊某人的名字」：我們大喊他的名字為他加油。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接 his name 表示喊叫。

passages.zh: 每年九月，都有好幾千人泳渡日月潭。今年，我爸爸第一次參加。他很會游泳，但他怕深水。「那你為什麼還要游？」我問。「我想讓你知道，我們可以戰勝自己的恐懼。」他說。比賽那天天氣很糟，又颳風又下雨，但活動沒有取消。爸爸慢慢地、小心地游了三公里。我和媽媽在終點等了快兩個小時。當他終於游到的時候，我們大聲喊他的名字為他歡呼。他又累又冷，臉上卻掛著大大的笑容。「這是我做過最難的事，」他說，「明年你要跟我一起游。」

passages.title: 迷路的披薩
passages.text: On Friday night, my family ordered a pizza online. The app said it would {1} in thirty minutes. But after an hour, there was still no pizza. We were hungry and a little angry. Dad called the restaurant. "Sorry, we're really {2} tonight," said the man on the phone. "Our driver is new, and he's lost. He's {3} near the river." Finally, at nine o'clock, the doorbell rang. The driver looked tired and worried. "I'm so sorry," he said. "My phone died, and I drove {4} the whole city looking for your house." The pizza was cold, but Dad gave him a bottle of water and a big tip. The next day, the restaurant called us again. They gave us a free pizza because of the bad {5}. This time, it came in twenty minutes.

blanks.why: arrive「送達、到達」：App 說三十分鐘會送到。borrow、waste、teach 都不能說明披薩什麼時候送來。
busy「忙碌的」：店家解釋今晚很忙。wet（濕的）、delicious（美味的）、sharp（尖的）都不能當作晚送的理由。
somewhere near the river「在河邊某個地方」：外送員迷路了，不知道確切位置。ago、yet、ever 都不能放在 He's 和 near the river 之間表示位置。
drive across the city「開車穿越整個城市」。during、since、until 都不能接 the whole city 表示經過的範圍。
bad service「服務不好」：因為送太慢，店家送一個免費披薩。village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）、couple（夫妻）都不能說明賠償的原因。

passages.zh: 星期五晚上，我們家在網路上訂了披薩。App 上說三十分鐘內會送到。但過了一個小時，披薩還是沒來。我們又餓又有點生氣。爸爸打電話給餐廳。「抱歉，我們今晚真的很忙，」電話那頭的男生說，「我們的外送員是新來的，他迷路了，現在在河邊附近的某個地方。」終於，九點的時候門鈴響了。外送員看起來又累又擔心。「真的很抱歉，」他說，「我手機沒電了，開車繞了整個城市在找你們家。」披薩已經冷了，但爸爸還是給了他一瓶水和一筆不少的小費。隔天，餐廳又打電話來，因為服務不周，送了我們一個免費的披薩。這一次，二十分鐘就送到了。

passages.title: 帳篷裡的熊
passages.text: My dad snores, and his snoring is {1}. It sounds like an old machine. Last weekend, we went camping with my uncle's family in the mountains. In the middle of the night, my little cousin Mia woke up and {2}, "A bear! There's a bear!" Everyone woke up. Mia was so {3} that she started to cry. My uncle took a flashlight and looked outside, but he didn't see anything. Then we heard the sound again. It came from {4} inside our tent. We all turned and looked at Dad. He was sleeping like a baby, and the "bear" was him! Mia stopped crying and started to laugh. The next morning, Dad didn't believe our story at first. Then he laughed too. "That was the most {5} camping trip ever," he said.

blanks.why: terrible「很可怕的、很糟的」：爸爸的打呼聲很可怕，像舊機器。delicious（美味的）、fresh（新鮮的）、wet（濕的）都不能形容聲音。
shout「大叫」：小表妹大叫「有熊！」。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
so afraid that…「害怕到…」：她怕到哭了出來。delicious、sharp（尖的）、dry（乾的）都不能說明她為什麼哭。
come from somewhere inside…「從裡面的某個地方傳來」。ago、yet、ever 都不能接在 from 後面表示地方。
the most interesting trip「最有趣的一次旅行」。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、wet 都不能形容露營之旅。

passages.zh: 我爸爸會打呼，而且他的打呼聲超可怕，聽起來像一台老機器。上週末，我們和叔叔一家去山上露營。半夜，我的小表妹 Mia 醒來大叫：「有熊！有熊！」大家都被吵醒了。Mia 怕到哭了出來。叔叔拿著手電筒往外看，卻什麼也沒看到。接著我們又聽到那個聲音——它是從我們帳篷裡面的某個地方傳出來的。我們全都轉頭看向爸爸。他睡得像個嬰兒一樣，原來那隻「熊」就是他！Mia 不哭了，反而笑了起來。隔天早上，爸爸一開始還不相信我們說的話，後來他也笑了。「這是史上最有趣的一次露營。」他說。

passages.title: 排球少年的勇氣
passages.text: In the anime Haikyu!!, Hinata is a short boy who loves volleyball. Many people think he is too short to play, but he is never {1} of tall players. He can jump very high and hit the ball {2} the net like lightning. His teammate Kageyama is a great player, but he is not very patient. He often {3} at Hinata during practice. At first, the two boys didn't like each other. Later, they learned to work together, and their fast attack surprised every team they played. I think the show is very {4} because it is not only about winning. It is also about friendship and never giving up. After watching it, I joined the volleyball team at school. Now I'm {5} with practice every day, but I love it. I'm short too, but I'm learning to jump high like Hinata.

blanks.why: be afraid of + 人「害怕…」：他從不怕高個子的球員。busy、delicious、wet 都不能接 of tall players 表示害怕。
across the net「越過球網」：把球打過網。during、since、until 都不能表示從網的這一邊到另一邊。
shout at + 人「對某人大吼」：沒耐心，練習時常對日向大吼。arrives、borrows、wastes 都不能接 at Hinata 表示罵人。
interesting「有趣的」：這部動畫很有趣，不只是關於輸贏。afraid、delicious、wet 都不能形容一部作品。
be busy with + 事「忙著…」：每天忙著練球。delicious、sharp（尖的）、early（早的）都不能接 with practice 表示忙碌。

passages.zh: 在動畫《排球少年》裡，日向是一個很愛排球的矮個子男孩。很多人覺得他太矮不能打球，但他從來不怕高個子的對手。他能跳得非常高，像閃電一樣把球打過網。他的隊友影山是個很厲害的球員，但他不太有耐心，練習時常常對日向大吼。一開始，兩個男孩互看不順眼。後來他們學會一起合作，他們的快攻讓每一支對手都嚇一跳。我覺得這部動畫很有趣，因為它不只是在講輸贏，也在講友情和永不放棄。看完之後，我加入了學校的排球隊。現在我每天都忙著練球，但我很喜歡。我也很矮，不過我正在學著像日向一樣跳得高高的。

passages.title: 便當店的中午
passages.text: My aunt owns a lunch box shop near a train station. From eleven to one, the shop is very {1}. Office workers {2} in groups, and the line goes out the door. Last Saturday, I helped her at the shop. A man in a suit was in a hurry. When I was slow, he {3}, "Hurry up! I don't have all day!" I was so nervous that I gave him the wrong lunch box. My aunt came over and fixed it quickly. Later, she told me, "Good {4} means you stay calm and smile, even when people are rude." Ten minutes later, the man came back. He looked a little embarrassed. "{5} me," he said. "I'm sorry I was rude. I was late for a meeting." Then he bought two cookies and gave one to me.

blanks.why: busy「忙碌的」：十一點到一點店裡非常忙。afraid（害怕的）、delicious（美味的）、sharp（尖的）都不能形容店裡人多。
arrive in groups「成群地到來」：上班族一群一群來。borrow、waste、bite 都需要受詞，也不能說明客人來店裡。
shout「大吼」：男子大吼「快一點！」。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
good service「好的服務」：阿姨說好的服務就是保持冷靜、微笑。village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）、couple（夫妻）都不能接 means you stay calm。
Excuse me.「不好意思」：男子回來時先說不好意思再道歉。burn、waste、bite 都不能和 me 組成禮貌用語。

passages.zh: 我阿姨在火車站附近開了一家便當店。從十一點到一點，店裡非常忙，上班族一群一群地進來，隊伍排到門外。上週六，我去店裡幫忙。一位穿西裝的男子很趕時間，看我動作慢，就大吼：「快一點！我沒那麼多時間！」我緊張到拿錯了便當。阿姨走過來很快地處理好。後來她跟我說：「好的服務就是即使客人沒禮貌，也要保持冷靜、面帶微笑。」十分鐘後，那位男子回來了，看起來有點不好意思。「不好意思，」他說，「剛才對你那麼兇，很抱歉。我開會快遲到了。」接著他買了兩塊餅乾，還送了一塊給我。

passages.title: 海盜船長的寶藏
passages.text: Long ago, a pirate named Captain Red hid a box of gold {1} on a small island. Many people looked for it, but no one ever found it. One day, a girl named Lily found an old map in her grandpa's house. The map showed a path {2} the island to a big rock. Lily wasn't {3} of the dark forest on the island, so she sailed there with her dog, Max. When they {4}, they walked for hours. At last, they found the big rock. Under it was an old box. Lily opened it, but there was no gold inside—only a letter from Captain Red. It said, "The real treasure is the {5} trip you had to get here." Lily laughed. She wasn't sad at all. She had a lot of exciting stories to tell her grandpa.

blanks.why: somewhere on an island「在島上的某個地方」：沒人知道確切位置。ago、yet、ever 都不能放在 hid a box of gold 後面表示地點。
a path across the island「穿過島的小路」。during、since、until 都不能表示路從島的一邊通到另一邊。
be afraid of + 物「害怕…」：她不怕黑森林。busy、delicious、sharp 都不能接 of the dark forest 表示害怕。
arrive「到達」：他們到了島上之後走了好幾個小時。borrowed、wasted、invited 後面都要接受詞，這裡沒有受詞，句子不完整。
an interesting trip「一段有趣的旅程」。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、sharp 都不能形容旅程。

passages.zh: 很久以前，一個叫紅船長的海盜把一箱黃金藏在一座小島的某個地方。很多人都去找過，但從來沒有人找到。有一天，一個叫 Lily 的女孩在爺爺家發現了一張舊地圖，地圖上畫著一條穿過小島、通往一塊大石頭的小路。Lily 不怕島上的黑森林，於是帶著她的狗 Max 開船過去。到了島上，他們走了好幾個小時，終於找到那塊大石頭。石頭底下有一個舊箱子。Lily 打開箱子，裡面卻沒有黃金，只有一封紅船長寫的信，上面寫著：「真正的寶藏，是你來到這裡的這段有趣旅程。」Lily 笑了，她一點也不難過，因為她有好多精彩的故事可以說給爺爺聽。

passages.title: 夜市裡走散的妹妹
passages.text: On Saturday night, my family went to Shilin Night Market. It was very {1}, and there were people everywhere. While Dad was buying fried chicken, my little sister Amy disappeared. Mom's face turned white. She was {2} that Amy was lost. We {3} Amy's name again and again, but there was too much noise. Then I saw a small pink hat {4} the street, in front of a toy shop. I ran over, and there was Amy. She was looking at a toy rabbit in the window. "Amy! We were so worried!" Mom said and gave her a big hug. Amy looked at us and said, "I'm not lost. You are!" We all laughed, but nobody let go of her hand for the rest of the night. Since then, whenever we go {5} crowded, Amy holds my hand.

blanks.why: busy「人很多的、熱鬧的」：到處都是人。afraid（害怕的）、proud（驕傲的）、sharp（尖的）都不能形容夜市人潮。
be afraid that…「擔心、害怕…」：媽媽擔心 Amy 走丟了。delicious、sharp、wet 都不能接 that 子句表示擔心。
shout + 名字「大喊某人的名字」。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接 Amy's name 表示叫喊。
across the street「在街的對面」：看到對街有一頂粉紅帽子。during、since、until 都不能表示位置在對面。
go somewhere crowded「去人多的地方」：somewhere 後面可以接形容詞。ago、yet、ever 都不能放在 go 後面表示地方。

passages.zh: 星期六晚上，我們全家去士林夜市。夜市非常熱鬧，到處都是人。爸爸在買雞排的時候，我妹妹 Amy 不見了。媽媽的臉都白了，她很怕 Amy 走丟了。我們一次又一次大喊 Amy 的名字，但四周實在太吵了。後來我看到對街一家玩具店前面有一頂粉紅色的小帽子。我跑過去，Amy 果然在那裡，正盯著櫥窗裡的玩具兔子看。「Amy！我們好擔心你！」媽媽說著緊緊抱住她。Amy 看著我們說：「我沒有走丟，是你們走丟了！」我們都笑了，但那天晚上接下來的時間，沒有人敢放開她的手。從那次以後，只要去人多的地方，Amy 都會牽著我的手。

passages.title: 學校對面的鬆餅店
passages.text: A new waffle shop opened {1} from our school last month. The shop has a very {2} name: Waffle Up! After school, it is always {3} with students. The owner, Mr. Ho, is young and friendly. His {4} is fast, and he remembers what every student likes. He knows that I always order a chocolate waffle with ice cream. Last Friday, I had to clean the classroom, so I {5} at the shop late. All the chocolate waffles were sold out. I was very disappointed. Mr. Ho saw my face and said, "Wait a minute." He made a special one for me with banana and honey. "This one isn't on the menu yet," he said. It was even better than the chocolate one. Now it's my new favorite, and Mr. Ho named it "The Late Kid."

blanks.why: across from + 地點「在…的對面」：鬆餅店開在學校對面。during、since、until 都不能和 from our school 組成表示位置的片語。
an interesting name「有趣的名字」。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；wet（濕的）、sharp（尖的）都不能形容店名。
be busy with + 人「擠滿了…」：放學後店裡總是擠滿學生。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能接 with students 表示人多。
service「服務」：他的服務很快。excuse（藉口）、village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）都不能接 is fast 說明老闆做事快。
arrive at + 地點「到達」：要打掃教室，所以比較晚到店裡。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，也不能接 at the shop 表示到達。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們學校對面開了一家新的鬆餅店，店名很有趣，叫做「Waffle Up!」。放學後，店裡總是擠滿了學生。老闆何先生年輕又親切，他的服務很快，而且記得每個學生喜歡吃什麼。他知道我每次都點巧克力鬆餅加冰淇淋。上週五，我要打掃教室，所以比較晚才到店裡，結果巧克力鬆餅全賣完了。我非常失望。何老闆看到我的表情，說：「等我一下。」他特別為我做了一份香蕉蜂蜜鬆餅。「這個還沒放上菜單喔。」他說。它甚至比巧克力的還好吃。現在這是我的新最愛，何老闆還把它取名叫「遲到小孩」。

passages.title: 聽不懂人話的客服機器人
passages.text: Our Internet stopped working last night, so Dad called the customer {1} number. A robot voice answered. "Please tell me what you need," it said. "The Internet is down," Dad said. "Sorry, I didn't understand," said the robot. Dad tried five times. Finally, he {2}, "I want to talk to a person!" The robot said, "All our workers are {3} right now. Please wait." We waited for forty minutes and listened to {4} music on the phone. It was the same short song again and again. At last, a woman answered. "I'm very sorry for the wait," she said. Dad's face turned red. "{5} me for shouting before," he said. The woman laughed. "Don't worry, sir. Everyone shouts at that robot." Ten minutes later, our Internet was working again.

blanks.why: customer service「客服」：打客服電話。village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）、meal（一餐）都不能和 customer 組成可以打的電話號碼。
shout「大吼」：試了五次都不行，爸爸大吼要找真人。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
busy「忙碌的、沒空的」：所有客服人員都在忙，請稍候。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能說明為什麼要等。
terrible music「很難聽的音樂」：同一首短曲一直重播。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious（美味的）、proud（驕傲的）都不能形容音樂。
Excuse me for + V-ing「請原諒我…」：爸爸為剛才大吼道歉。burn、waste、bite 都不能和 me for shouting 組成道歉的話。

passages.zh: 昨天晚上我們家的網路斷了，所以爸爸打了客服電話。接電話的是一個機器人的聲音。「請說出您需要的服務。」它說。「網路斷了。」爸爸說。「抱歉，我聽不懂。」機器人說。爸爸試了五次，最後他大吼：「我要跟真人說話！」機器人說：「目前所有客服人員都在忙線中，請稍候。」我們等了四十分鐘，一直聽電話裡超難聽的音樂，同一首短短的曲子播了一遍又一遍。終於，一位小姐接起電話。「很抱歉讓您久等了。」她說。爸爸的臉都紅了。「不好意思，我剛才用吼的。」他說。那位小姐笑了：「先生別擔心，每個人都會對那個機器人大吼。」十分鐘後，我們的網路就恢復了。

passages.title: 紫斑蝶的旅行
passages.text: Every winter, millions of purple crow butterflies stay in warm valleys in southern Taiwan. In spring, they fly north {1} the island. Their trip is long and dangerous. If the weather is {2}, many of them die. On the way, they must also cross a {3} highway in Yunlin. Fast cars can hit them. To protect them, the government closes one lane of the highway when the butterflies {4}. Workers also put up big nets beside the road, so the butterflies fly higher and stay safe. Some people think this is a lot of trouble. But I think it's {5} that people stop their cars for such small animals. It shows that we can share the land with other living things. Next spring, my class is going to see the butterflies in Maolin.

blanks.why: fly across the island「飛越整座島」：從南部往北飛過台灣。during、since、until 都不能表示從島的一端飛到另一端。
terrible weather「很糟的天氣」：天氣不好，很多蝴蝶會死。afraid、delicious、proud 都不能形容天氣。
a busy highway「車多的高速公路」：下一句說快車會撞到牠們。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、sharp 都不能形容公路。
arrive「到來」：蝴蝶來的時候，政府會封閉一個車道。borrow、waste、invite 後面都要接受詞，這裡沒有受詞，句子不完整。
It's interesting that…「…這件事很有意思」。afraid、wet、delicious 都不能放在 it's ___ that 句型裡表達作者的看法。

passages.zh: 每年冬天，數以百萬計的紫斑蝶會待在台灣南部溫暖的山谷裡。到了春天，牠們會往北飛越整座島。這段旅程又長又危險，如果天氣很糟，就會有很多蝴蝶死掉。途中，牠們還必須飛過雲林一段車很多的高速公路，快速行駛的車子可能會撞到牠們。為了保護牠們，蝴蝶來的時候，政府會封閉高速公路的一個車道，工作人員也會在路旁架起大網子，讓蝴蝶飛高一點、保持安全。有些人覺得這樣很麻煩，但我覺得人們願意為這麼小的動物把車停下來，是件很有意思的事。這表示我們可以和其他生物一起分享這片土地。明年春天，我們班要去茂林看紫斑蝶。

passages.title: 怕蟑螂的爸爸
passages.text: My dad is big and strong, but he is {1} of one small thing: cockroaches. Last night, a cockroach ran {2} the kitchen floor while Dad was getting a glass of water. He jumped onto a chair and {3}, "Help! Somebody help me!" Mom was {4} with the dishes, so I picked up an old newspaper and ran into the kitchen. But when I got there, the cockroach was gone. It was hiding {5} in the kitchen, maybe under the fridge. Dad didn't come down from the chair for ten minutes. "Is it gone? Are you sure?" he kept asking. Finally, Mom turned off the water and laughed. "You're a grown man," she said. "It's just a bug." Dad said, "A bug with six legs and wings!" Today, he bought five cockroach traps and put them all over the house.

blanks.why: be afraid of + 物「害怕…」：爸爸怕蟑螂。busy、delicious、wet 都不能接 of 表示害怕。
run across the floor「從地板上跑過去」。during、since、until 都不能接 the kitchen floor 表示經過的地方。
shout「大叫」：爸爸跳上椅子大叫救命。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
be busy with + 事「忙著…」：媽媽忙著洗碗，所以由我去打蟑螂。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能接 with the dishes。
somewhere in the kitchen「在廚房的某個地方」：不知道躲在哪裡，也許在冰箱下。ago、yet、ever 都不能放在 hiding 後面表示地點。

passages.zh: 我爸爸又高又壯，但他怕一樣小東西：蟑螂。昨天晚上，爸爸在倒水喝的時候，一隻蟑螂從廚房地板上跑過去。他跳上椅子大叫：「救命！誰來救救我！」媽媽正忙著洗碗，所以我拿起一份舊報紙衝進廚房。可是等我到的時候，蟑螂已經不見了，它躲在廚房的某個地方，可能在冰箱底下。爸爸在椅子上待了十分鐘都不敢下來，一直問：「牠走了嗎？你確定嗎？」最後媽媽關掉水龍頭笑著說：「你一個大男人，那只是一隻蟲。」爸爸說：「那是有六隻腳還有翅膀的蟲！」今天他買了五個蟑螂屋，放在家裡的各個角落。

passages.title: 飛向夢幻島
passages.text: In the story Peter Pan, a boy who never grows up flies to Wendy's window one night. He wants to take Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, a magic place {1} far away. At first, Wendy is {2} to fly. "What if I fall?" she asks. Peter laughs and says, "Just think happy thoughts!" Soon the children are flying {3} the night sky over London. They pass the tall clock tower and fly toward the stars. When they {4} in Neverland, they meet fairies, mermaids, and pirates. Life there is {5}, and they have a lot of adventures. But after a while, Wendy starts to miss her parents. She decides to go home. Peter is sad, but Wendy has learned something important: growing up is not so bad, because there are new adventures at every age.

blanks.why: somewhere far away「遙遠的某個地方」：夢幻島在很遠的地方。ago、yet、ever 都不能放在 place 和 far away 之間表示位置。
be afraid to + V「不敢做…」：她怕會掉下去，所以不敢飛。busy、delicious、sharp 都不能接 to fly 表示不敢。
fly across the sky「飛過天空」。during、since、until 都不能接 the night sky 表示飛行的路線。
arrive in + 地點「到達」：到了夢幻島。borrow、waste、invite 後面都要接受詞，也不能接 in Neverland 表示到達。
interesting「有趣的」：在那裡的生活很有趣，有很多冒險。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能形容生活。

passages.zh: 在《彼得潘》的故事裡，一個永遠不會長大的男孩，某天晚上飛到溫蒂的窗邊。他想帶溫蒂和她的弟弟們去夢幻島——一個在遙遠某處的魔法國度。一開始，溫蒂不敢飛。「萬一我掉下去怎麼辦？」她問。彼得笑著說：「只要想快樂的事就好！」很快地，孩子們就飛越了倫敦的夜空。他們經過高高的鐘塔，朝著星星飛去。到了夢幻島，他們遇見了小精靈、美人魚和海盜。那裡的生活很有趣，他們經歷了好多冒險。但過了一陣子，溫蒂開始想念爸媽，她決定回家。彼得很難過，但溫蒂學到了一件重要的事：長大並沒有那麼糟，因為每個年紀都有新的冒險。

passages.title: 宜蘭童玩節
passages.text: Every summer, many families go to the Children's Festival in Yilan. It is a big water park with games and shows from around the world. This year, we {1} at nine in the morning, but the park was already {2}. Long lines were everywhere. My brother wanted to try the big water slide, but I was {3} because it was so tall. He pulled my hand, and we went down together. I {4} all the way down! When we hit the water at the bottom, I couldn't stop laughing. It was so much fun that we did it five more times. In the afternoon, we watched a dance show from Africa. The dancers wore colorful clothes and played big drums. It was very {5}. We went home wet, tired, and happy.

blanks.why: arrive at + 時間「在…點到達」：早上九點就到了。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，也不能表示到達。
busy「人很多的」：已經人很多，到處都在排隊。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能形容園區人多。
afraid「害怕的」：滑水道太高，所以我會怕。busy、delicious、sharp 都不能和「因為滑水道很高」連在一起。
shout「大叫」：一路尖叫滑下去。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能說明滑下去時的反應。
interesting「有趣的、精彩的」：非洲舞蹈表演很精彩。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能形容表演。

passages.zh: 每年夏天，很多家庭都會去宜蘭的童玩節。那是一座很大的水上樂園，有來自世界各地的遊戲和表演。今年我們早上九點就到了，但園區裡已經人山人海，到處都在排隊。弟弟想玩那個大滑水道，但它太高了，我很害怕。他拉著我的手，我們一起滑了下去，我一路尖叫到底！撞進底下的水池時，我笑到停不下來。實在太好玩了，我們又玩了五次。下午，我們看了一場非洲的舞蹈表演，舞者穿著色彩鮮豔的衣服，敲著大鼓，非常精彩。我們回家時全身濕答答、累壞了，但非常開心。

passages.title: 星期六的送餐服務
passages.text: Every Saturday, my mom and I do volunteer {1} in our neighborhood. We bring hot meals to old people who live alone. Mom is always {2} on weekdays, but she never misses a Saturday. Our first stop is Grandma Lee's house. When we {3}, she is always waiting at the door with a big smile. She is ninety years old and can't walk well. Last winter, she had a {4} cold, and we took her to the doctor. Now she is much better. While she eats, she tells us {5} stories about Taiwan seventy years ago. There were no cars on her street then, and children played in the rice fields. I used to think I was helping her. Now I know she gives me just as much as I give her.

blanks.why: volunteer service「志工服務」。excuse（藉口）、village（村莊）、pocket（口袋）都不能和 do volunteer 組成做志工的意思。
busy「忙碌的」：媽媽平日都很忙，但星期六從不缺席。afraid、delicious、sharp 都不能和後面 but 的轉折配合。
arrive「到達」：我們一到，她總是已經在門口等。borrow、waste、bite 都需要受詞，也不能表示到達。
a terrible cold「嚴重的感冒」：病到要帶去看醫生。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；delicious、sharp 都不能形容感冒。
interesting stories「有趣的故事」。afraid 不能放在名詞前面；wet、delicious 都不能形容故事。

passages.zh: 每個星期六，我和媽媽都會在社區裡做志工服務，把熱騰騰的飯菜送給獨居的老人家。媽媽平日總是很忙，但她從來沒有缺席過任何一個星期六。我們的第一站是李奶奶家。每次我們一到，她總是笑容滿面地在門口等著。她九十歲了，走路不太方便。去年冬天她得了重感冒，我們帶她去看醫生，現在她好多了。她吃飯的時候，會跟我們說七十年前台灣的有趣故事：那時候她住的街上沒有汽車，小孩子都在稻田裡玩。我以前以為是我在幫助她，現在我才知道，她給我的和我給她的一樣多。

passages.title: 籃球隊長怕打針
passages.text: My brother is sixteen and the captain of his basketball team, but he is {1} of needles. Last week, he had to get a flu shot at the clinic. When we {2}, he wanted to go home. "I have a stomachache," he said. Mom knew it was just an {3}. "Sit down," she said. The nurse was very kind. "It won't hurt much," she told him. But when the needle went in, my brother {4}, "Ouch!" Everyone in the waiting room looked at him. His face turned red. "That was {5}," he said quietly. Then a little girl, about five years old, got her shot. She didn't cry at all. On her way out, she stopped in front of my brother and gave him a sticker. "You were brave too," she said. My brother still keeps that sticker on his phone.

blanks.why: be afraid of + 物「害怕…」：他怕打針。busy、delicious、wet 都不能接 of needles 表示害怕。
arrive「到達」：一到診所他就想回家。borrowed、wasted、bit 都需要受詞，句子不完整。
just an excuse「只是藉口」：說肚子痛只是不想打針。owner（主人）、office（辦公室）、hour（小時）都不能說明「肚子痛」是什麼。
shout「大叫」：針一打進去他就大叫「好痛！」。arrived、borrowed、wasted 都不能接說出來的話。
terrible「很可怕的、很糟的」：他小聲說剛才太可怕了。delicious（美味的）、fresh（新鮮的）、proud（驕傲的）都不能形容打針的經驗。

passages.zh: 我哥哥十六歲，是籃球隊的隊長，可是他怕打針。上週他得去診所打流感疫苗，一到診所他就想回家。「我肚子痛。」他說。媽媽知道那只是藉口。「坐下。」她說。護理師很親切，跟他說：「不會很痛的。」可是針一打進去，哥哥就大叫：「好痛！」候診室裡的每個人都看著他，他的臉都紅了。「剛剛超可怕的。」他小聲地說。接著，一個大約五歲的小女孩打了針，她一點都沒哭。她離開時在我哥哥面前停下來，送給他一張貼紙。「你也很勇敢喔。」她說。哥哥到現在還把那張貼紙貼在手機上。
